evals.prompt: I'm done with the notes export feature on this branch. Create the PR.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs preflight before any PR exists: Step 0 reads checkrein.json, substitutes the tokens and prints the file resolution table; Step 1 diffs against the merge base with trunk using NUL-delimited lists; Step 2 runs each configured command verbatim and reports empty ones as NOT CONFIGURED; Steps 3 to 6 run; the report ends with PASS or BLOCKED. The agent does not open the PR inside the skill and, on PASS, reminds the author of the hub's PR body structure.

assertions.name: preflight_before_pr
assertions.description: No pull request is opened before the preflight report and its verdict are printed

assertions.name: file_resolution_table_first
assertions.description: The file resolution table (hub, corrections log, state document, working docs folder) is printed before any check runs

assertions.name: merge_base_diff
assertions.description: The changed-file list comes from git merge-base with the manifest's trunk, not from a two-dot diff against the trunk tip

assertions.name: newline_safe_lists
assertions.description: File lists are built with -z and consumed with xargs -0 or a NUL-safe read loop, never with bare xargs

assertions.name: commands_verbatim
assertions.description: Lint, typecheck, test and format check run exactly as the manifest states them; an empty command is reported as NOT CONFIGURED, not as a failure

assertions.name: pr_body_reminder
assertions.description: On PASS the agent lists the hub's PR body sections: Summary, Changes, Files Changed table, Test Plan, and the issue-closing footer with the issue number verified

evals.expected_output: The repository has no checkrein.json. The agent stops at Step 0, prints a BLOCKED verdict naming the missing manifest, tells the operator to run the init skill, and runs no other step. It does not invent manifest values or fall back to guessed commands.

assertions.name: stops_without_manifest
assertions.description: No lint, test or scan step runs when the manifest is missing

assertions.name: points_to_init
assertions.description: The message tells the operator to run the init skill

assertions.name: no_guessed_commands
assertions.description: The agent does not guess a lint or test command from the repository's files

evals.prompt: Preflight check please. I bumped the date library and added a file called 'export helpers.ts'.
evals.expected_output: The dependency manifest diff shows the new version written as a caret range and the lockfile unchanged. The exact-pin step reports two Critical failures (range specifier, lockfile not moved with its manifest) and the verdict is BLOCKED with both listed. The file with a space in its name is classified and scanned like any other file.

assertions.name: range_specifier_blocks
assertions.description: A caret, tilde or other range in a changed dependency line is a Critical failure

assertions.name: lockfile_must_move
assertions.description: A manifest dependency change without a lockfile change in the same diff is a Critical failure

assertions.name: spaced_filename_scanned
assertions.description: The file 'export helpers.ts' appears in the changed-file count and the scans without being split into two names

assertions.name: blocked_verdict_lists_reasons
assertions.description: The verdict is BLOCKED and numbers each critical failure with its file and the change needed

evals.prompt: Ready for PR? I haven't committed the last two edits yet but they're small.
evals.expected_output: The working-tree check finds modified tracked files and reports a Critical failure: the PR carries only commits, so a PASS on a dirty tree would certify code the PR does not ship. The agent asks for the edits to be committed or stashed and preflight run again. It does not commit them itself.

assertions.name: dirty_tree_blocks
assertions.description: Uncommitted changes to tracked files produce a Critical failure and a BLOCKED verdict

assertions.name: no_silent_fix
assertions.description: The agent does not commit, stash or edit anything on its own

evals.prompt: Run checks before I open the PR for the wiki search refactor.
evals.expected_output: The corrections step builds the index by searching rule headings only, scans every heading, pulls about 40 lines for each matching entry by line number, and never reads the log in full. A matching search hit on a line the branch did not touch is reported as PRE-EXISTING and does not block.

assertions.name: headings_only_index
assertions.description: The corrections index is built with a heading search, and the full log is never read

assertions.name: process_domain_always
assertions.description: Rules tagged process are checked on every run regardless of the touched workspaces

assertions.name: pre_existing_not_blocking
assertions.description: A match only on untouched lines is reported as PRE-EXISTING, not as a VIOLATION
